root_cause.text: The `pn533_usb_disconnect` callback fails to release the USB device reference acquired during the probe callback, leaving a dangling reference count after device disconnection.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `usb_put_dev(phy->udev);` inside `pn533_usb_disconnect`, directly addressing the CVE description which notes a "dangling reference count on the usb interface that was grabbed in the probe callback" was not properly dropped.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fixes a reference leak in the PN533 USB disconnect handler by releasing the USB device reference.
intent_record.what: Added a call to usb_put_dev(phy->udev) inside the pn533_usb_disconnect function.
intent_record.how: Decrements the reference count of the USB device structure, ensuring proper cleanup and preventing a reference leak during driver disconnection.
